text.description_html:
RK International CK-307, White Porcelain Knob with Polished Chrome Base

The clean look of the White Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Chrome Rose is accentuated by the freshness that chrome on white brings. Modern, yet cozy, this porcelain cabinet knob is dripping with glamor. The White Porcelain Cabinet Knob is available in either a 1 inch diameter or a larger 1-1/4 inch diameter. It comes packaged with installation hardware.

Also Available Matching: White Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Brass Rose

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-307 White Porcelain Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: White
  • Base Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Available in 2 Sizes

    RKI-CK-307:
    • Diameter: 1"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"

    RKI-CK-303:
    • Diameter: 1-1/4"
    • Projection: 1-5/8"

Sold Individually
